name: ANVIL_ST_WAIT
meaning: Update case 0: waits for `dropping` and the end of the anim, then starts ANVIL2 and goes to 2 (inferred)

name: ANVIL_ST_LIFT
meaning: Update case 1: on anim end starts STAND0, hides the anvil and goes to 3 (inferred)

name: ANVIL_ST_HOLD
meaning: Update case 2: holds 2000 ms after the drop, then releases the scripted camera and goes to 1 (inferred)

name: ANVIL_ST_DONE
meaning: entered hidden from 1; Update has no case 3 (inferred)
